seo.title: Best Wine Bars in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the top 12 wine bars in Casablanca, Morocco. From chic rooftops to cozy bistros, find the perfect spot for Moroccan and international wines, tapas, and unforgettable experiences. Updated for 2026.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's burgeoning culinary scene extends to its wine offerings, with a vibrant mix of upscale establishments, cozy bistros, and chic lounges where you can savor excellent Moroccan and international wines, often paired with delightful tapas or gourmet small plates.

picks.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched dramatically over the Atlantic, Le Cabestan offers an unparalleled dining and wine experience. Known for its sophisticated atmosphere and breathtaking ocean views, it boasts an extensive wine cellar featuring both celebrated Moroccan labels and international classics. Ideal for a special occasion or a luxurious evening of wine tasting.
picks.whatToOrder: A bottle of organic Moroccan wine (e.g., Domaine du Val d'Argan) paired with fresh oysters or a selection of refined tapas.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table by the window at sunset for the most spectacular views. Their sommelier is excellent for recommendations.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Cabestan is a must-visit in Casablanca. The views are insane, and their wine list, especially the Moroccan reds, always impresses. Worth every penny."

picks.name: La Bodega de Casablanca
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A lively and authentic Spanish-style tapas bar, La Bodega is a local favorite for its vibrant atmosphere and diverse selection of wines and sangrias. It's the perfect spot to enjoy small plates, socialize, and explore a range of accessible Moroccan and Spanish wines in a relaxed setting.
picks.whatToOrder: A pitcher of classic Sangria or a bottle of red (e.g., Ksar d'Atlas) with a mix of patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, and chorizo.
picks.insiderTip: It gets very busy, especially on weekends; arrive early or be prepared to wait for a table. Don't miss their live music nights.
picks.redditQuote: "La Bodega is my go-to for a fun night out. Great vibe, decent wines for the price, and the tapas are addictive. Always a good crowd."

picks.name: Bistrot Chic
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bistrot Chic offers a refined yet cozy atmosphere reminiscent of a Parisian brasserie. With a focus on classic French cuisine and an expertly curated wine list, it's a superb choice for discerning palates. Their selection leans towards French and European wines, perfect for pairing with their gourmet dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of Sancerre or Bordeaux paired with their duck confit or a cheese platter.
picks.insiderTip: The outdoor terrace is lovely during cooler evenings. Ask for their 'plat du jour' for a fresh, seasonal option.
picks.redditQuote: "Bistrot Chic has that perfect French elegance. Their wine knowledge is impressive, and the food is consistently excellent. Great for a date night."

picks.name: Rick's Café
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Immortalized by the movie 'Casablanca,' Rick's Café is more than a restaurant—it's an experience. While famous for its cocktails, its wine list is respectable, offering a selection of local and international labels in a beautifully recreated 1940s setting. A unique spot for a drink and a trip back in time.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Moroccan red wine or a glass of sparkling wine while enjoying the piano player's tunes.
picks.insiderTip: Visit in the evening to fully appreciate the ambiance and live piano music. Reservations are highly recommended, especially for dinner.
picks.redditQuote: "Okay, Rick's Café is touristy, but it's worth it for the vibe. Had a decent Moroccan Syrah there and just soaked it all in. Very cool place."

picks.name: Lily's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Lily's is a stylish and contemporary venue known for its chic decor and vibrant atmosphere. It offers a refined menu of modern European dishes complemented by a well-chosen selection of international wines. It's a popular spot for Casablanca's trendy crowd looking for a sophisticated night out.
picks.whatToOrder: A crisp white wine from the Loire Valley or a full-bodied Spanish red with their signature appetizers.
picks.insiderTip: Often hosts DJ nights later in the evening, transforming into a livelier spot. Dress smart casual.
picks.redditQuote: "Lily's always delivers on atmosphere and good food. Their wine list isn't huge, but they have solid options that pair well with everything. Trendy but not pretentious."

picks.name: Le Boudoir
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Boudoir offers a more intimate and cozy setting, perfect for relaxed conversations over a glass of wine. With plush seating and soft lighting, it provides a discreet escape from the city's bustle. Their wine selection features a good balance of local and French labels, accompanied by light bites.
picks.whatToOrder: A Moroccan rosé (e.g., Gris de Boulaouane) with a selection of artisanal cheeses and charcuterie.
picks.insiderTip: It's a great spot for pre-dinner drinks or a quiet nightcap. Service is attentive and discreet.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want a chill, classy place for wine, Le Boudoir is it. Super cozy and not too loud. Good selection of French wines."

picks.name: Le Relais de Paris (L'Entrecôte)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While famed for its single-item menu of steak frites, Le Relais de Paris also offers a robust wine list focusing on French classics that perfectly complement their rich, buttery sauce. It's a bustling brasserie experience where good wine is an essential part of the traditional French meal.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass or bottle of Bordeaux or a robust Cabernet Sauvignon to pair with the entrecôte.
picks.insiderTip: They don't take reservations, so prepare for a wait during peak hours. The experience is all about the steak and wine pairing.
picks.redditQuote: "Love Relais de Paris for their steak, but their wine selection is surprisingly good for a single-dish place. A decent Cotes du Rhone always hits the spot."

picks.name: Le Gatsby
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Embodying the glamour of the Roaring Twenties, Le Gatsby is an upscale bar and restaurant offering a sophisticated atmosphere and an impressive drink menu. While cocktails are prominent, their wine list is carefully curated, featuring premium labels from around the world. It’s an ideal spot for a luxurious evening.
picks.whatToOrder: An elegant sparkling wine or a high-quality New World red to enjoy with their jazz nights.
picks.insiderTip: Check their schedule for live music or DJ events. Dress code is smart elegant.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Gatsby is incredibly chic, feels like you're stepping into another era. Their wine selection is top-notch, and the ambiance is just perfect for a classy drink."

picks.name: Le Petit Rocher
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated right on the rocks overlooking the ocean, Le Petit Rocher offers stunning panoramic views, especially at sunset. It's primarily a seafood restaurant, but its tranquil setting makes it an excellent choice for enjoying a crisp white wine or rosé. The wine list complements their fresh seafood perfectly.
picks.whatToOrder: A chilled Moroccan white wine (e.g., Fes Blanc) with grilled fish or calamari.
picks.insiderTip: Go just before sunset for incredible photo opportunities and to enjoy the changing light over the Atlantic.
picks.redditQuote: "Petit Rocher has the best views, hands down. A bottle of cold white wine there while watching the waves is pure bliss. Food is good too!"

picks.name: La Cocina
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Cocina brings a delightful blend of Spanish and Moroccan flavors to its menu, creating unique tapas and main courses. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and their wine list features a good range of Spanish and Moroccan wines, perfect for exploring new pairings with their fusion dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: Try a flight of different Moroccan wines to pair with their varied tapas selection.
picks.insiderTip: Their paella is excellent and pairs well with a robust red wine. Check out their daily specials.
picks.redditQuote: "La Cocina's tapas are amazing, and they have a surprisingly good selection of Spanish wines. Perfect for sharing with friends."

picks.name: Rouge
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located within the Anfa Place Mall, Rouge offers a sleek and contemporary environment with a focus on modern cuisine and a refined beverage program. While not a dedicated wine bar, its stylish setting and curated wine list make it a great option for a sophisticated wine-drinking experience alongside creative dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of international Chardonnay or a bold Cabernet Sauvignon from their well-stocked cellar.
picks.insiderTip: Excellent spot for people-watching, especially if you get a table near the promenade overlooking the ocean.
picks.redditQuote: "Rouge is super stylish, perfect for a chic evening. Had a really nice Argentinian Malbec there that wasn't overly priced. Good vibe for a modern spot."

picks.name: Vertigo (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: As part of the luxurious Four Seasons Hotel, Vertigo offers an elevated experience with stunning views, impeccable service, and an extensive selection of premium wines and spirits. It’s a top choice for those seeking an indulgent evening in a sophisticated setting, with an emphasis on high-quality international labels.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of premium Champagne or a fine vintage red from their exclusive collection.
picks.insiderTip: Perfect for a celebratory drink or a glamorous evening. The prices reflect the luxury experience, but the quality is unmatched.
picks.redditQuote: "Vertigo at the Four Seasons is splurge-worthy. The views are amazing, and their wine list is incredible – found some rare Italian whites there. Definitely a special occasion place."

faq.question: What kind of wine is produced in Morocco?
faq.answer: Morocco has a long history of winemaking, primarily producing red wines, rosés, and some whites. Common grape varieties include Carignan, Cinsault, Grenache, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot for reds and rosés. For whites, you'll often find Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, and Chenin Blanc. Moroccan wines are increasingly gaining international recognition for their quality and unique terroir.

faq.question: Is it easy to find wine in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Yes, it is relatively easy to find wine in Casablanca, especially in restaurants, hotels, and dedicated wine shops or supermarkets in wealthier neighborhoods. While Morocco is a Muslim country, it has a significant tourism industry and a more liberal attitude towards alcohol compared to some other Muslim-majority nations. Upscale establishments and international hotels almost always serve alcohol.

faq.question: What is the typical price range for a glass of wine in Casablanca?
faq.answer: The price for a glass of wine in Casablanca can vary significantly depending on the venue and the wine's origin. In a casual bar or restaurant, a glass of local wine might cost between 60-90 MAD ($6-9 USD). At more upscale establishments or for imported wines, prices can range from 90-150 MAD ($9-15 USD) or more per glass.

faq.question: Are there any specific Moroccan wines I should try?
faq.answer: Absolutely! For reds, look for labels like Domaine de Sahari, Volubilia, or Ksar d'Atlas, often made with Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, or a blend. For rosés, Gris de Boulaouane is a popular and refreshing choice. For whites, Domaine Val d'Argan (especially their Sauvignon Blanc) and some Fes Blanc varieties are highly recommended. Don't hesitate to ask your sommelier for local recommendations.

faq.question: Do wine bars in Casablanca serve food?
faq.answer: Most wine bars and restaurants in Casablanca that serve wine will also offer food. This can range from light bites and tapas, perfect for pairing with wine, to full-course meals. Many of the establishments listed above are primarily restaurants with excellent wine programs, ensuring you have delicious food options alongside your wine selection.

faq.question: What is the general atmosphere like in Casablanca's wine bars?
faq.answer: The atmosphere in Casablanca's wine bars is quite diverse, reflecting the city's cosmopolitan nature. You can find everything from lively Spanish-style tapas bars with live music to chic, modern lounges, elegant French bistros, and luxurious hotel bars with stunning views. Dress codes can vary from casual smart to elegant, so it's good to check beforehand, especially for upscale venues.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best wine bars is based on extensive research, local recommendations, and user reviews, focusing on wine quality, ambiance, service, and food pairings. Venues were personally vetted for their unique offerings and overall experience.
